  overlap colengths vanish) and NONE of which touches a chart (the file imports only

  at :201/:257). Under SwallowedBy, hsep is immediate: every off-diagonal pair contains
  a missing piece, and DivisorFamilyAffCollapse.lean:95 subsingleton_ovlColength_of_disjoint
  already proves the vanishing. So (c2)finite/(c2)proj/(c3)/(c4) are DERIVABLE in

  sum. DivisorFamilyAffAssemble.lean:79-84 nevertheless takes all five as hypotheses,
  and its docstring (:24-26) justifies this by citing I-0340: ''they cannot be free,
  since the vanishing diagonal makes (c4) imply flatness of the diagonal overlap colengths''.
  That inference is wrong as an obstruction argument — the diagonal factor is ovlColength
  i i, which for the swallowing piece is the colength itself and for a missing piece
  is subsingleton, so the required flatness is exactly what (c1) already delivers.
  The refutation of ''free for ANY adaptation'' does not refute ''free under SwallowedBy''.
  Net effect: the widened assembler is strictly weaker than DivSchemeCertZarSep''s,
  and the value the lane advertises (clause (c1) for a straddling divisor) is delivered
  while the glued half is pushed onto the caller.

vehicle comparison of R2.  Its value at an affine open is the widened value of the chart-typed

    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
